parameters.name: AuthenticationCode1
parameters.description:
The first verification code.

>  You can call the [CreateVirtualMFADevice](~~186179~~) operation to create an MFA device and generate a key (value of `Base32StringSeed`). Then, use the key on the Alibaba Cloud app to manually add an MFA device, and obtain the two consecutive verification codes.

parameters.name: AuthenticationCode2
parameters.description:
The second verification code.

>  You can call the [CreateVirtualMFADevice](~~186179~~) operation to create an MFA device and generate a key (value of `Base32StringSeed`). Then, use the key on the Alibaba Cloud app to manually add an MFA device, and obtain the two consecutive verification codes.

parameters.name: SerialNumber
parameters.description:
The serial number of the MFA device.

>  You can call the [CreateVirtualMFADevice](~~186179~~) operation to obtain the serial number of the MFA device.

parameters.name: UserPrincipalName
parameters.description: The logon name of the RAM user.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ims bind-mfa-device --serial-number acs:ram::1772422852740000:mfa/device001 --user-principal-name test@example.onaliyun.com --authentication-code-1 123456 --authentication-code-2 654321 --region cn-hangzhou
